paite: "Huai hun chiang in van-gam tuh nungak siangthou sawm, akhawnvak uh tawi a mouneipa dawn ding a pawtte toh teh ahi ding hi.
heading: Nungak Siangthou Sawm Gentehna
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

paite: Huchi in alak ua nga ahai ua, nga apil uhi.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

paite: Ahaite'n akhawnvak uh atawi ua, atui atawi kei uhi.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

paite: Apilte'n bel akhawnvakte uh tawi in, a-um ah atui leng atawi uhi.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

paite: Huan mouneipa hong zekai ziak in avek un alusu ua, ana ihmuta uhi.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

paite: "Ngai dih uh! Zan lai in, 'Mouneipa ahong e; adawn ding in hong pawt un,' chi in kikou ging ahong omta hi.
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

paite: Huaitak in nungak siangthoute athou vek ua, akhawnvakte uh ahahsiang uhi.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

paite: Huan ahaite'n apilte kiang ah, 'Na khawnvaktui uh hon pe sam un; ka khawnvak uh mit ding in akisa,' achi uhi.
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

paite: Himahleh, apilte'n, 'Kou leh nou a ding in akiching kei ding; azuakte kiang ah pai unla, va lei zaw un,' chi in adawng uhi.
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

paite: Huan lei ding a apaimang kal un mouneipa ahong tungta a; huchi in amansate amah toh kitenna ankuang um ding in alut ua; huan, kongkhak akhakta uh.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

paite: "Huai nung in nungak siangthou dangte leng ahong tung ua, 'Toupa, toupa, hon hon in,' achi uhi.
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

paite: Himahleh ama'n, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ka hon thei ngei kei,’ chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

paite: "Huaiziak in kiging un, ani leh ahun na theih louh ziak un.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

paite: "Van lalgam tuh mi gamdang a pai dia kisa, asikhate sam a, akiang ua asumte kemsak bang ahi.
heading: Talent Gentehna Thu
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

paite: Sikha khat kiang ah talent nga apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent nih apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent khat apia a; ahihtheih hundan ding chiat ua pia in apaita hi.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

paite: Talent nga mupa huai in ava sumsin pah a, talent nga dang amukheta hi.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

paite: Huchi mah bang in talent nih mupa'n leng talent nih dang amukhia hi.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

paite: Talent khat mupa bel ava kuan a, lei atou a, apu dangka aphumgu zawta hi.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

paite: "Hun sawtpi nung in huai sikhate pu amau toh asum tungtang hihfel ding in ahong pai hi.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

paite: Talent nga mupa ahong pai a, talent nga dang ahon tawi a, 'Pu, nang talent nga na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nga dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

paite: Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih hi, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

paite: "Talent nih mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, nang talent nih na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nih dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

paite: Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih e, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

paite: "Huan talent khat mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, mi chihhakpi na hi chih ka hon thei a; na tuhlouhna ah leng na at a, na thehlouhna ah leng na khawm hi.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lau a, ka va pai a, lei ah na talent ka selgu a; en in, nang a ngei na mu nawn,' achi hi.
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

paite: "Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha gilou leh zongzaw, ka tuhlouhna ah ka at a, ka thehlouhna ah leng ka khawm chih na thei maw?
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

paite: Huchi ahih ngalleh sumsinte kiang a ka dangka na koih ding hi a, huchi a ka hong pai a kei a apung toh ka muh nawn ding ahi.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

paite: Huaiziak in atalent khat laksak unla, talent sawm neipa kiang ah pia un.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

paite: Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahong hau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

paite: Huan sikha phatuam lou polam mial ah paikhia un, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' chi in adawng hi.
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

paite: "Himahleh, Mihing Tapa, a-angelte tengteng toh athupina a kivan a ahong pai hun chiang in, athupina laltutphah ah atu ding hi.
heading: Vaihawmna Ni
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

paite: Ama ah nam chih akikhawm ding ua; belamchingpa'n kel lak a pan belamte akhenkhia bang in amaute akhenkhe ding hi.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

paite: Belamte ataklam ah akoih ding a, aveilam ah kelte akoih ding hi.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Kumpipa'n ataklam a mite kiang ah, 'Ka Pa deihsakte aw, hong pai un, khovel siamchil a pan nou a dia gam bawlsa luah un.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

paite: Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pia ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pia uh; mikhual ka hih in na hon zintun ua;
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

paite: vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak uh; ka chi anat a, ka kiang a na hong ziak un,' achi ding hi.
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

paite: "Huai hun chiang in, midiktatte'n, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial a ka hon muh ua nek ding ka hon piak uh? Dangtak a ka hon muh ua, dawn ding ka hon piak uh?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

paite: Chik in ahia mikhual a ka hon muh ua, ka hon zintun ua, vuaktang a ka hon muh ua, puan ka hon silhsak uh?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

paite: Chik in ahia china in hiam suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na kiang a ka hong uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

paite: Kumpipa'n amaute kiang ah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai ka unau neupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih uh ka tung a hih na hi uh,' chi in adawng ding hi.
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

paite: "Huai khit in, aveilam a mite kiang ah leng, 'Nou hamse thuakte aw, tangtawn mei diabol leh asawltakte dia mun bawl ah hon paimangsan un;
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

paite: Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pe kei ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pe kei ua;
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

paite: mikhual ka hih in, na hon zintun kei uh; vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak kei ua; china leh suangkul a ka om a, na hon veh louh ziak un,' achi ding hi.
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

paite: "Huai hun chiang in amau leng, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial hiam, vuaktang hiam, china hiam, suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na nna ka hon sepsak louh uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai mineupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih louh uh ka tung a hih lou na hi uh' chi in adawng ding hi.
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

paite: Huan huaite tangtawn gawtna ah apai ding ua; midiktatte bel tangtawn hinna ah apai ding uhi,” achi hi.
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
